body.zh: 作者最近现实里比较忙，要过一段时间才能回来更新，v0.6.14 会作为长期稳定版本。遇到问题或有建议，欢迎到 GitHub 提 issue，或在 QQ 群 1062538743、Discord 反馈。
body.en: The author is busy offline for a while and won't be updating for some time, so v0.6.14 will serve as the long-term stable version. For problems or suggestions, please open a GitHub issue, or reach us in the QQ group 1062538743 or on Discord.

body.zh: 0.6.1 及更早版本激活 Shizuku 后，会在本机留下一个任何应用都能连的 adb 服务。升级到 0.6.2 后第一次打开会自动清理；暂时不升级的话，重启手机也能清掉。
body.en: After activating Shizuku, versions 0.6.1 and earlier leave an adb server on the device that any app can connect to. The first launch after updating to 0.6.2 cleans it up automatically; if you can't update yet, restarting the phone also clears it.

body.zh: 只想放行一个会话：确认框里勾「这个会话后面的特权命令都允许」。全都不想逐条确认：设置 → 设备与权限 →「特权命令不再逐条确认（风险自负）」。
body.en: To allow just one session, tick "Allow all later privileged commands in this session" in the prompt. To stop confirming them altogether: Settings → Device & permissions → "Stop confirming privileged commands one by one (at your own risk)".
